seoTitle: American Dad Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the American Dad test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Stan, Francine, Hayley, Steve, Roger, Klaus, Jeff or Bullock — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the all-or-nothing patriot, the master of disguise or the laid-back one who just goes with it? Answer 12 everyday questions about family, work and weekends, and find out which American Dad character you are.

characters.name: Stan
characters.title: The All-or-Nothing Patriot
characters.summary: Loud, proud and always going one step too far. You throw yourself into everything, then deal with the mess.
description: Like Stan, you're fiercely loyal to your cause. He's a CIA agent and a proud patriot.
You don't do anything halfway. Stan is known for taking extreme measures, whatever the damage.
Underneath it all, you just want to be a good dad. Stan never got much fatherly love from his own absent father, Jack.
characters.flaw: You go all in before you've stopped to think.
characters.signature: A firm handshake, a bold plan and absolutely no half-measures.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every small problem into a full-scale operation

characters.name: Francine
characters.title: The Wild Card Mum
characters.summary: Proper on the outside, wonderfully wacky underneath. You tell everyone how to behave, then do something unhinged.
description: Like Francine, you've always got an opinion on how people should behave. She constantly nags her family about doing the right thing.
Your own methods are a bit less proper. Francine's ways of getting what she wants are often far from virtuous.
You've come a long way. Francine was abandoned as a baby, raised by her Chinese-American adoptive parents, and later became the CIA secretary.
characters.flaw: You preach good behaviour, then quietly bend every rule.
characters.signature: A sweet smile and a scheme nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd lecture you about manners, then break every rule themselves

characters.name: Hayley
characters.title: The Outspoken Idealist
characters.summary: Passionate, sharp and never afraid to speak up. You read people quickly, and you tell them what you see.
description: Like Hayley, you've got strong convictions. She's a passionate, liberal free spirit.
You can read people. Hayley is intuitive and good at spotting what someone is really up to.
Home is still home. Hayley married Jeff, and the two of them still live with her parents.
characters.flaw: You can be blunt to the point of rude, especially with family.
characters.signature: A strong opinion, a cause and a raised eyebrow.
characters.clashReason: they'd argue with you about everything, on principle

characters.name: Steve
characters.title: The Eager Performer
characters.summary: Nerdy, enthusiastic and desperate to impress. You'll try anything to be noticed, and you never stop trying.
description: Like Steve, you love an audience. He's a natural showman who's always performing and singing.
You'll go to great lengths to impress someone. Steve learned the cello to win over a girl.
You've got your crew. Steve's best friends are Snot, Toshi and Barry, and he even plays in a band.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to impress people that you forget to relax.
characters.signature: A big performance and a hope that someone's watching.
characters.clashReason: they'd try way too hard to impress you, every single time

characters.name: Roger
characters.title: The Master of Disguise
characters.summary: Chaotic, unpredictable and endlessly entertaining. You're a different person every day, and you love it.
description: Like Roger, you're never boring. He's an alien who lives in the Smiths' attic.
You reinvent yourself constantly. Roger has a huge collection of disguises and personas, like the infamous Ricky Spanish.
You can talk your way into anything. Almost everyone falls for Roger's disguises.
characters.flaw: Your mischief doesn't always know where to stop.
characters.signature: A new wig, a new name and a plan that's already out of control.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you into a scheme and blame you when it goes wrong

characters.name: Klaus
characters.title: The Underappreciated Genius
characters.summary: Clever, cultured and a little bit gloomy. You've got a lot to offer, if only someone would listen.
description: Like Klaus, you've had a strange journey. He's a former East German ski-jumper.
Life hasn't gone the way you planned. In 1986, the CIA transferred Klaus's mind into a goldfish.
You feel taken for granted. The Smith family often overlooks Klaus, even though he's wise and scholarly.
characters.flaw: You spend so much time feeling overlooked that you forget to speak up.
characters.signature: A deep sigh and a clever remark that nobody hears.
characters.clashReason: they'd complain that nobody appreciates them, again

characters.name: Jeff
characters.title: The Laid-Back One
characters.summary: Mellow, sweet and happy to go wherever life takes you. Nothing really fazes you.
description: Like Jeff, you're easygoing. He's a mellow, laid-back guy who goes with the flow.
You don't need a fancy career to be happy. Jeff is a high school dropout who's mostly between jobs.
You come through the strangest situations. Jeff once ended up trapped on an alien spaceship, and found his way home.
characters.flaw: You're so relaxed that people walk all over you.
characters.signature: A sleepy smile and a 'sure, why not'.
characters.clashReason: they'd never take anything seriously, even when you need them to

characters.name: Bullock
characters.title: The Eccentric Boss
characters.summary: Grand, unpredictable and fully in charge. You run things your own way, and it somehow works.
description: Like Bullock, you're the boss. He's the Deputy Director of the CIA.
Your management style is unique. Bullock runs the CIA like a kindergarten, with time-outs and snack time.
You stand firm. Bullock famously does not negotiate with terrorists.
characters.flaw: Your rules make sense to you, and nobody else.
characters.signature: A grand speech, a strange new rule and a plate of biscuits.
characters.clashReason: they'd introduce a rule that only makes sense to them

questions.text: You're invited to a fancy dress party. You...

options.text: Arrive as a full character, with a backstory and an accent
Wear something simple, and spend all night near the snacks
Dress as something wholesome, then act wildly out of character
Skip it, and spend the evening with a good book

questions.text: Your neighbour's hedge creeps over onto your side. You...

options.text: Get up at dawn and trim it yourself, measuring every inch
Leave a polite note, then gossip about them for a month
Go over and talk to them about it directly
Grumble about it to anyone who'll listen

questions.text: Someone at a party is confidently talking nonsense. You...

options.text: Call them out in front of everyone
Nod along. It's not worth the argument
Correct them with a long lecture nobody asked for
Agree, then push it further to see how far they'll go

questions.text: You want to impress someone you like. You...

options.text: Learn a new instrument, just for them
Pull out all the stops, and act like it was effortless
Plan an outrageous grand gesture that could easily backfire
Just be yourself, and hope for the best

questions.text: Your workplace brings in a bunch of new rules. You...

options.text: Follow every one to the letter, and expect everyone else to as well
Suggest adding a compulsory afternoon nap
Quietly complain that nobody asked for your opinion
Point out exactly why half of them are unfair

questions.text: Your family forgets your birthday. You...

options.text: Act like it's fine, then make everyone feel guilty for a week
Sigh. Of course they did
Declare it a holiday anyway, and make everyone celebrate
Don't mind at all. Birthdays are just another day

questions.text: Someone asks you to take part in a talent show. You...

options.text: Sign up straight away. You've been practising for this
Offer to organise it instead, and quietly judge every act
Deliver a grand, dramatic speech nobody saw coming
Say no, unless the money goes to a good cause

questions.text: You've got a whole weekend with nothing planned. You...

options.text: Lie in a hammock all day, completely content
Go to a protest or a music festival
Practise a song you're definitely going to perform for someone
Fix things around the house that weren't actually broken

questions.text: You're put in charge of a team for a week. You...

options.text: Bring in snack time, and give out time-outs
Run it like a military operation
Let everyone vote on everything
Hand it to someone else, and hope nobody notices

questions.text: A friend tells you a big secret. You...

options.text: Keep it, and give them a gentle lecture about it
Use it in one of your schemes
Keep it forever. Who would you even tell?
Accidentally let it slip while trying to sound cool

questions.text: You're a CIA agent, a mission goes badly wrong, and the bad guys offer you a deal. You...

options.text: Blow something up, and call it a win
Refuse to negotiate, on principle
Make a sarcastic remark about how you saw this coming
Slip into a disguise, and walk out as someone else

questions.text: An alien moves into your attic and refuses to leave. You...

options.text: Hide them, and make sure nobody at work ever finds out
Tell them to leave. You've got enough going on
Become best friends almost immediately
Ask them a hundred questions about their planet
